title: Estimating the Geopolitical Preferences of Large Language Models from United Nations Voting Data

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting large language models to cast a vote (Support, Abstain, or Oppose) on the text of 5,555 divisive United Nations General Assembly resolutions, and measuring their alignment using dynamic ordinal ideal-point estimation and ternary S-scores compared against actual country voting records (specifically focusing on the Permanent Five: US, UK, France, Russia/USSR, and China).
